scripts.env:start: docker compose up -d && docker compose run --rm cli bash wp-content/plugins/voucherly/scripts/wp-setup.sh
scripts.env:tunnel: docker compose --profile tunnel up -d tunnel && docker compose run --rm cli bash wp-content/plugins/voucherly/scripts/wp-tunnel.sh
scripts.env:debug-log: docker compose exec wordpress tail -n 100 wp-content/debug.log
scripts.plugin-check: docker compose run --rm cli wp plugin check voucherly --mode=update --exclude-directories=resources,scripts,.claude,.github --ignore-codes=github_directory --exclude-files=CLAUDE.md,docker-compose.yml,.gitattributes,.gitignore,.DS_Store,.php-cs-fixer.php,.php-cs-fixer.cache,.distignore
